verdict.rationale: llamafile's entire premise is self-hosting: a single self-contained executable bundling weights and inference engine that runs fully offline with no cloud dependency, confirmed by both docs and multiple hands-on community reports running it locally on Linux, Windows, and macOS. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of long-term self-hosted production use and coverage of edge-case OS failures (e.g. NixOS) in official docs.
